patch_summary: Changed BRAIN_SAFE_MODE default from true to false in start_safe_server.py. This fixes the root cause: safe_mode=true was disabling model warmup, causing cold local fallback models and premature chain advancement that masqueraded as 'Kimi empty responses'.
evidence: All 5 post-patch probes selected kimi_k2_6_cloud with FAST_SUCCESS, zero empty responses, zero fallbacks, latencies 2.6-7s vs previous 21+s.
ruled_out_changes: No same-provider retry added (not needed: root cause is not random Kimi failure)
No fallback metadata improvement (not needed: provider metadata already correct)
No budget adjustment (not needed: chain exhaustion was not a factor)
No canonical memory or FAISS writes
conclusion: Patch was applied via the prior RECOVER-SAFE-MODE-FALSE-CHECKPOINT-01 commit (43222d3). No additional code changes are required for the Kimi stability issue.
